integrity: Geometric fixed-point, finite-field norm–trace and Frobenius orbit assertions are proved in RESULT.md, with reproducible finite computations. No independent validation or audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the explicitly displayed cyclic plane curve over Fq is treated, and only tangent-line maximal contact. The characteristic-three quartic case with 28 hyperflexes is already known (Oyono–Ritzenthaler 2010 and earlier work); it is not a novelty claim. General results on nonclassical tangency are prior mathematics. Historical priority for the uniform higher-degree closed-point spectrum is provisional. The exact finite-field program corroborates q=2,3,4,5, not the full theorem.
title: The maximal-contact locus on cyclic Frobenius plane curves
